raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so 349 txn_ids are exact duplicates in raw that differ only in ingest_ts. 327 of those are POSTED and show up as duplicate keys in silver, which inflates the 2026-01-17 volume and every gold aggregate. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver_transactions fixes it, and the gold tables rebuild correctly from there.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1"}}
